hook: apropos 是得體相關，opprobrium 是公開譴責——櫃台一側送賀卡，一側丟番茄。
script: apropos／apposite＝貼切。opprobrium／opprobrious＝辱罵恥辱。口令：賀卡寫「說得巧」，番茄寫「別亂砸」。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 賀卡: apropos walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「賀卡」出場：apropos 一上場梗就黏住——切題的。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 剛好章: apposite walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「剛好章」出場：apposite 一上場梗就黏住——貼切的。

members.senseAnchor: state of disgrace resulting from public abuse; a state of extreme dishonor; - F.D.Roosevelt
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 番茄箱: opprobrium walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「番茄箱」出場：opprobrium 一上場梗就黏住——譴責恥辱。

members.senseAnchor: expressing offensive reproach; (used of conduct or character) deserving or bringing disgrace or shame; - Rachel Carson
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 罵名牌: opprobrious walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「罵名牌」出場：opprobrious 一上場梗就黏住——辱罵的。

related.synonyms: abusive, scurrilous, black, disgraceful, ignominious, inglorious
